title: Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1992
ACT IV OF 1992
PUNJAB GOVERNMENT
EMPLOYEES WELFARE FUND
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992
An Act further to
amend the Punjab Government
Employees Welfare
Fund Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
4th June, 1992]
No. Legis.2(12)/92/34, dated
4-6-1992.--The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 28th
day of May, 1992 and assented -to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 2nd day
of June, 1992, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Government Employees
Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force with
effect from 1st November, 1991.
